conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.event_type="call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR textPayload:"call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR textPayload:"call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR textPayload:"call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR textPayload:"call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_divergent")

documentation.content:
A held symbol was blocked because its cost-basis floor could not be resolved or diverged from the cross-check (fail-closed - no call written). Persistent firing means a symbol is stuck unwritable. FC-050/FC-065 lineage.

ROLL PATH (added by FC-100). Since FC-100 the covered-call service also rolls (cc-roll-daily, 15:30 ET), and the roller resolves the SAME floor before it prices either leg - so the `call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_*` pair is watched here too. On the roll path a fail-closed skip means the position was NOT rolled and may be assigned; on the scan path it means no new call was written. Both are correct behaviour, not bugs, but a symbol that fires daily is inert with no other signal.

- `..._unresolved` (reason `no_broker_basis`): Alpaca reported no usable `avg_entry_price` for the equity lot. This is the silent-inert mode - every position skips, no error is raised. Check the position in the Alpaca account (PA37XLNWDLB3).
- `..._divergent`: Alpaca's basis and the lots reconstructed from `covered_call.trades_from_activities` disagree beyond tolerance. The broker number is resolved and VETOED. Reconcile the assignment history before overriding anything.

Note: on this account most lots are operator-bought, not assigned, so `cost_basis_cross_check_unavailable reason=no_assignment_history` is the EXPECTED event on every scan and every roll. It is not a divergence and does not fire this policy - the broker basis is used as the floor.

Triage: gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND jsonPayload.event_type=~"cost_basis"' --limit=20 --freshness=1d

Plan: docs/plans/fc-100.md (the roll pair); FC-050/FC-065 (the floor)
